statement: SDL Xbox360 HIDAPI parser accepts packets whose first byte is 0x00 and decodes D-pad hat and buttons from bytes 2-3, analog triggers from 4-5 into signed SDL axis domain, sticks from LE16 at 6-13 with OS-specific Y inversion, and delivers mapped SDL face/guide events. The 829a65d path preserves the same basic decoder with added Steam handling.
